message: Scribe is documentation and workflow-capture software that turns actions taken in applications into step-by-step how-to guides an IT team can share. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: On the free Basic plan the buyer can, in the browser and without purchase, generate a how-to guide for one IT procedure they currently carry in their head, and Scribe's Autocapture can turn work already performed into such guides automatically, with sensitive data automatically redacted during capture. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
